description: This file defines the interface 'DittoLogger' in Java, which extends SLF4J's Logger with additional methods for managing a correlation ID within the MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context). It includes methods for setting, deriving, and discarding correlation IDs to facilitate contextual logging in an asynchronous environment.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the given correlation ID for the subsequent log operation; supports method chaining.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from provided WithDittoHeaders for the next log operation.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Obtains the correlation ID from given DittoHeaders for the next log operation.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for all subsequent log operations until explicitly discarded; returns an AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger for try-with-resources.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders for all subsequent log operations until manually discarded.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Obtains correlation ID from DittoHeaders for all subsequent logs until discarded.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the currently set correlation ID from the MDC.
